integrity: Complete proof and an independently implemented small-field exhaustive checker accompany the result. Finite computations corroborate but are not used as an infinite-field proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The rank-profile identities for one-sided ideals are already in Rahimi-Alangi and Yahaghi (2015), Corollary 2.5, and are credited. The claimed new result is the rank-conditioned sharp dimension difference, complete attainable interval, extremal locus geometry and cardinality. The theorem applies only to radical generators in full upper triangular matrix algebras; intermediate gap-fiber counts and pattern-algebra generalizations are open here. No independent validation or priority audit.
title: Sharp quadratic one-sided ideal gap in triangular matrix radicals
